description: Update a conversion action's settings. Spending/deletion: preview, then owner-approved confirm:true with the same requestId. Other edits: one call. Creates request active; report returned status and claim live only when active. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_update_conversion_action.

accountId.description: The connected ad account in Soclo.

adAccountId.description: Advertiser/ad account selected from your Soclo connection.

confirm.description: True only after owner approval of spending/deletion preview.

expectedBudgetAmount.description: Approved preview amount; changes require a new preview.

expectedBudgetType.description: Approved preview budget type: daily or lifetime.

category.description: conversion_action.category. Defaults to DEFAULT on create.

clickThroughLookbackWindowDays.description: Days after an ad click a conversion still counts.

requestId.description: Reuse this request ID for confirmation and outcome recovery.
